It pertains to a contract between "Plant PPU & CDW" and a "Client," with the contract code "RHQ, EPCM-3 (P-25)" and Document ID "6746-CMG-000-CA-0005." The tkIS Contract No. is 66-6746.

children.title: ON ACCOUNT PAYMENTS
1.0 SECURED ADVANCE ON MATERIALS
children.content:
Secured Advance shall be paid as per the General Conditions of Contract of OWNER. However, no
secured advance shall be paid against the material wherever milestone payment has been recommended
on receipt and acceptance of material at site
children.summary: This text outlines a specific condition regarding the payment of Secured Advance. Generally, Secured Advance is paid according to the OWNER's General Conditions of Contract. However, a crucial exception is made: **no Secured Advance will be paid for materials when a milestone payment has already been recommended upon the material's receipt and acceptance at the site.** This means that if a milestone payment is triggered by the delivery and approval of materials, a separate Secured Advance for those same materials will not be issued.

children.summary: This document outlines the progressive payment terms for a contractor across various work categories, including Civil, Structural, Architectural, Electrical, and Package Items, as well as Annual Maintenance Contracts. Payments are released against certified running account bills, with necessary deductions. Specific payment percentages are tied to project milestones like completion of work phases, submission of documentation, material receipt, fabrication, installation, testing, and final completion. The Engineer-in-charge certifies progress and can approve further payment schedule breakdowns. The document also details conditions for bank guarantees for free-issue materials and notes regarding tax deductions and completion certificates.

This document details payment conditions for a contractor, focusing on progressive payments across various work categories (Civil, Structural, Architectural, Electrical, Package Items, and AMC). Payments are made against certified running account bills, with deductions. A key point is that **no Secured Advance will be paid for materials if a milestone payment has already been recommended upon their receipt and acceptance at the site.** Payment percentages are linked to project milestones such as work completion, documentation submission, material receipt, fabrication, installation, testing, and final completion. The Engineer-in-charge certifies progress and can approve further payment breakdowns. Bank guarantee requirements for free-issue materials, tax deductions, and completion certificates are also mentioned.

summary: This document, "Special Conditions of Contract - Part B (Commercial) Rev 00," is Annexure-B-I for a contract between "Plant PPU & CDW" and a "Client" (Contract Code: RHQ, EPCM-3 (P-25); Document ID: 6746-CMG-000-CA-0005; tkIS Contract No: 66-6746). It outlines payment terms for the contractor, detailing progressive payments for Civil, Structural, Architectural, Electrical, Package Items, and AMC work. Payments are made against certified running account bills, subject to deductions. Crucially, **no Secured Advance is paid for materials if a milestone payment has already been made upon their site receipt and acceptance.** Payment percentages are tied to project milestones like work completion, documentation, material receipt, fabrication, installation, testing, and final completion. The Engineer-in-charge certifies progress and can approve further payment breakdowns. Bank guarantees for free-issue materials, tax deductions, and completion certificates are also covered.
